config.scope: Node CPU field evaluation including preparation, index, validation, guards, candidate selection, and four receiver-rotor queries. Excludes fixture generation, output serialization, receiver load conversion, rendering, and dynamic evolution.
config.statistics: Median, p25, p75, min/max of per-field ms; paired candidate/exact ratios by repetition and deterministic paired bootstrap median-ratio interval. At least 10% median saving plus upper 95% interval below 1 is required for a provisional useful win; small or unstable differences are inconclusive.
config.memory_policy: No forced GC during field timing. Record heap and RSS before/after each repetition outside measured core, plus process resource usage. Values are process-level diagnostics, not precise per-method allocation cost.
config.stop_conditions: Exclusive serial execution required; source hash change invalidates run; nonfinite/checksum nondeterminism/domain failure stops case; 120 second hard process timeout; no escalation of workload after a failed speed/error gate.
